name: PANVIS-A
group: Shenzhen Institute of Advanced Biomedical Robot (Abrobo, Aibo Hechuang)
devices_driven: one 0.035-in guidewire + one 5F angiographic / 6F guiding catheter
validation_detail: RCT 64 robot vs 66 manual, 4 centres, NCT05778214 (zhang2026_safety)
key_numbers: success 100% both arms; operator dose 1.67+-3.49 vs 43.63+-38.95 uSv (zhang2026_safety abstract)
